description: Open one wiki page to somebody of the company who is not on its project, or to a company's group of people — or change what they hold, or take it back ('level': 'none'). 'level' is read, comment or edit. 'subtree': true opens the page WITH ALL ITS CHILD PAGES, those made or moved there later included, except a page that broke inheritance and what is beneath it; a page's own read restriction still keeps out whoever it does not name. 'days' ends it by itself (1–365); left out, until taken back. Not for guests outside the company — that is the screen's. The project's owner and administrators only. In the page's history and the company's journal.

days.description: Days until it ends by itself; left out, until taken back.

group.description: A company's group of people, by name or id, instead of one person.

level.description: read, comment, edit — or none to take it back.

subtree.description: true: the page and every page beneath it.

user.description: The person: username or address. Leave out when 'group' is given.

name: share_wiki_page
title: Share wiki page
